typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ReportName as string ('pfoxd105d vSphere World'),
	ClusterUtilization_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Name as string,
		{Interval Breakdown} as string,
		DataCenter as string,
		{Parent vCenter} as string,
		{CPU - Total Physical} as string,
		{CPU - Allocated Logical} as string,
		{CPU - P99} as string,
		{CPU - P95} as string,
		{CPU - P75} as string,
		{CPU - P50} as string,
		{CPU - Max} as string,
		{CPU - Average} as string,
		{CPU Provisioned MHZ} as string,
		{Memory - Total} as string,
		{Memory - Allocated} as string,
		{Memory - P99} as string,
		{Memory - P95} as string,
		{Memory - P75} as string,
		{Memory - P50} as string,
		{Memory - Max} as string,
		{Memory - Average} as string,
		{Memory - Balloon} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ClusterUtilizationfile
ClusterUtilizationfile derive(report_name = toString($ReportName),
		importdate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		{CPU_-_Max} as string,
		{Memory_-_Max} as string,
		Interval_Breakdown as string,
		{Memory_-_P95} as string,
		{Memory_-_P75} as string,
		CPU_Provisioned_MHZ as string,
		{Memory_-_Total} as string,
		{Memory_-_P50} as string,
		Name as string,
		{CPU_-_Allocated_Logical} as string,
		DataCenter as string,
		Parent_vCenter as string,
		{Memory_-_P99} as string,
		{Memory_-_Allocated} as string,
		{CPU_-_P95} as string,
		{CPU_-_P50} as string,
		report_name as string,
		{CPU_-_Total_Physical} as string,
		{CPU_-_P99} as string,
		{Memory_-_Average} as string,
		{CPU_-_P75} as string,
		{Memory_-_Balloon} as string,
		{CPU_-_Average} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		{CPU_-_Max} = {CPU - Max},
		{Memory_-_Max} = {Memory - Max},
		Interval_Breakdown = {Interval Breakdown},
		{Memory_-_P95} = {Memory - P95},
		{Memory_-_P75} = {Memory - P75},
		CPU_Provisioned_MHZ = {CPU Provisioned MHZ},
		{Memory_-_Total} = {Memory - Total},
		{Memory_-_P50} = {Memory - P50},
		Name,
		{CPU_-_Allocated_Logical} = {CPU - Allocated Logical},
		DataCenter,
		Parent_vCenter = {Parent vCenter},
		{Memory_-_P99} = {Memory - P99},
		{Memory_-_Allocated} = {Memory - Allocated},
		{CPU_-_P95} = {CPU - P95},
		{CPU_-_P50} = {CPU - P50},
		report_name,
		{CPU_-_Total_Physical} = {CPU - Total Physical},
		{CPU_-_P99} = {CPU - P99},
		{Memory_-_Average} = {Memory - Average},
		{CPU_-_P75} = {CPU - P75},
		{Memory_-_Balloon} = {Memory - Balloon},
		{CPU_-_Average} = {CPU - Average}),
	partitionFileNames:[($ClusterUtilization_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> ClusterUtilization
